tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Return the reviewed public facts for Pagosa Forest Lodge. No reservation data is exposed.

tools.name: search_stays
tools.description: Search this single property by destination, guest count, and bedrooms. No match says nothing about other Pagosa Springs lodging.

tools.name: check_availability
tools.description: Check authoritative availability for the requested stay. Provider outages return provider_unavailable, never stay_unavailable.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Request a complete current quote in USD. Incomplete charges or terms fail closed. A quote does not hold inventory.

tools.name: get_booking_link
tools.description: Revalidate a quote and return the official Lodgify checkout URL when verified. The guest reviews terms and completes checkout; no reservation is created.
